sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 15:08)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at Chemist Warehouse and Kathmandu, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at Shortland Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Customs Street all clear, no issues at this time.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing a full sweep.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Skymart, no issues to report.
Welfare checks at Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store and Eightyfed, all clear, no issues to report. On standby showing security presence.
All clear at the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street; heading back down Albert Street.
Albert Street all clear, no issues to report. Heading down Wellesley Street.
Just as we headed down, received a call from Remedy Coffee regarding an individual harassing customers. We arrived and removed the individual; no further issues. On standby showing security presence.
All clear at Remedy Coffee, no further issues to report.
Welfare checks conducted at McDonald's Queen Street, Banh Mi King and Localito, all clear, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone and on standby for any calls, staying vigilant and ready.
Welfare checks, no issues; heading to check on Darby Street and Elliott Street:
Darby Street, Lumi Cafe, Recycle Boutique, Celine Mediterranean restaurant, the Wilson Carpark, Elliott Street and Elliott Stables all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Q Theatre and checking on Aotea Square.
Aotea Square all clear; continuing towards Q Theatre.
Q Theatre is all clear; standing by for security presence.
Munster Inn and Nandos all clear. Heading to check on the Library area.
Library area all clear. The male individual from yesterday's altercation with the male member of the public was sighted in the area. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks on Lorne Street, no issues to report. Heading to the office for a 10-minute break and to use the restroom.
Received a call from Hasi asking us to come and retrieve a package for our manager Gina.
Package received; standing by at the office to hand the package over to Gina.

Received a call from someone who needed assistance, then withdrew the request as the individual concerned left of their own accord. We were unable to identify the caller as they hung up before we could find out.
Gina called to advise she will be there soon to retrieve the package.
Handed the package over to Gina. Continuing patrol towards High Street.
Welfare checks on the businesses on High Street, no issues to report. Heading towards Chancery Square via O'Connell Street.
Welfare check on O'Connell Street, Freyberg Square and Chancery Square; quiet with no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Vulcan Lane all clear, no issues to report. Heading towards the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street.
Welfare check on New Balance, Faradays, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store and Haven Mart. Heading through Fort Street to commence welfare checks.

Welfare checks on Evan's Kebab, KFC, Fort Lane, Fort Street, Right Track, Jo & Joes, Vape Haven, Vapor King, the Wilson Carpark, 77 Convenience Store and White Lady. Also just received a call from Footlocker Queen Street asking for assistance; heading to assist.

Arrived on site and asked where the individual was. The worker said he had left, and when we looked outside the door he was just walking out of Localito. He had not done anything wrong — just acting very suspiciously. (Photo on file.) Standing by for security presence.
Heading to the office to start break.
Afternoon guards running late; remaining on duty.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (15:07 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 1 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
First guard has arrived; awaiting the second guard's arrival (standing by 15:15).
Second guard has arrived on site; having a debrief before gearing up.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Mali Thai, Celine's and Lumi Cafe.

Full sweep of Elliott Street — Atrium food court, the Elliott Wilson Carpark, Domino's, Smashed Potatoes, Burger Express, Chicken n Chips n Fish, Mr Snacks and The Food Junction all clear, no issues. Arrived at Elliott Stables, maintaining presence (16:05–16:25).
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, all clear, no issues. Patrolling through Mid City.
Full sweep of Mid City with welfare checks on all stores in the area.
Welfare checks, all clear; commencing welfare checks down Queen Street:
Commencing a sweep down through Durham Street.
Full sweep of Durham Street; welfare check at the corner of Durham, both Wilson Carparks, Hazy Tiger and Durham Supermarket, all clear. Continuing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street with welfare checks from Farmers and Mecca to ANZ and Van Cleef & Arpels. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep of the area (17:35).
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, Commercial Bay Shopping Centre and the Downtown waterfront, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; standing by in the office to commence floor checks.
Floor checks completed; commencing a toilet break.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare checks on Mali Thai and Celine's, all clear.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check at the Wilson Carpark, Mr Snacks, Burger Express, Smashed Potatoes, The Food Junction, Domino's and Fresh Market, all clear.
Full sweep of Victoria Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, Countdown, Skymart Convenience Store, Hell's Pizza and The Fiddler.
Full sweep of Federal Street; arrived at Federal Square, commencing a sweep (19:15).
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare checks on the Cathedral, Hotel Indigo and Liston House, all clear. Patrolling down Swanson Street West to Albert Street.
Welfare checks on Swanson Street West, all clear; patrolling down Albert Street.
Full sweep of Albert Street; welfare check at Albert Mart and 11 Angels Bar, all clear. Patrolling down Lower Albert Street.
Full sweep of Lower Albert Street, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling Quay Street.
Welfare checks along Quay Street and the remaining businesses open, all clear. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep (20:05–20:30).
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Fort Lane.
Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check at Jo & Joes, KFC, the Wilson Carpark, Vape Haven, Haven Mart, Mr Murdochs and The Right Track, all clear. Heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone, which is on 1%.
Afternoon shift completed; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at Bar 101; the venue is open for the public holiday. Will be frequenting the area.

So far the venue is clear of trouble; crowds are just starting to arrive and everyone is just kicking off for the evening, with satisfactory behaviour at the moment. Will revisit later. Moving on up Victoria Street West.
Skymart welfare check; the merchant relayed no issues so far. Moderate foot traffic in the area.
Albert Street sweep done; not as busy as Victoria Street West, all clear. Continuing up Victoria Street West.

77 Convenience welfare check; the merchant relayed a suspicious male in the area entering and exiting the store. A description was provided. Partner and I will stand by shortly to show presence while awaiting response calls.

The suspicious male was spotted; he avoided entering the store on seeing us stationed outside and was last seen heading down Federal Street. The merchant has been advised to call us in the event of an incident. Moving along.
Sweep down Federal Street completed; area not as busy. Heading back to Queen Street.
Back on Queen Street, heading down.
Durham Street East all clear; foot traffic moderate at this hour.
Wyndham Street intersection; foot traffic picking up. Standing by to show presence while awaiting response calls.
All clear. Police cars active in the area; no issues in sight. Continuing down.
Vulcan Lane sweep; the area is not as busy but has decent foot traffic. No issues in the area.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; conducting checks.
Call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a trespassed male present in the area; attending to assist. Police have been called.
Checks all clear; the area is fairly busy at this end. Conducting a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart and standing by in the area to show presence, ready to attend.
Police have arrested the trespassed male.
Drunk civilians in the area coming from the Viaduct; no one causing trouble at the minute. Continuing patrols towards McDonald's and back up Queen Street; will revisit later.
Shortland Street all clear; continuing up High Street.
Vulcan Lane all clear; the back roads are not as busy as the main street.
Freyberg Square all clear and secured; area not as busy.
Back on Victoria Street East; heading to HQ to carry out floor checks.
Charging the phone, currently on 2%; awaiting response calls in the meantime.
Phone charged sufficiently to continue patrols.
Heading to Bar 101 for a welfare check.

Arrived at Bar 101. Staff relayed that patrons have been compliant for the most part, but they had a difficult removal who remained a nuisance at the front entrance afterwards. The male in question is currently across from the venue near the carpark. Standing by to show presence.
The male is still present in the area and is very intoxicated. Partner and I approached to ensure civilians' safety.

The male has been reunited with his peers, who are taking him home safely. Patrons from the venue have cleared out of Elliott Street; welfare ensured for all individuals present. Heading to McDonald's Queen Street for a welfare check.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; patrons from Bar 101 occupying the restaurant. Standing by for a short while.
Behaviour satisfactory, no complaints from staff. Continuing patrols.
Arrived at Aotea Square; conducting a sweep.
Sweep concluded; Aotea Square secured, no issues. Heading back down Queen Street.
On Victoria Street West, heading to Skymart for a welfare check.
Skymart all clear, busier than usual at this time; the merchant relayed no issues. Continuing up.
77 Convenience Store welfare check, all clear. Heading back to Queen Street.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; conducting checks.
Commercial Bay all clear; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, no issues. Heading back to HQ for break and handover with the morning team.

flags: CAPACITY: Afternoon guards arrived late — first guard 15:07, second guard 15:33; the Morning team held over until the 15:08 handover and afternoon patrols only commenced 15:41 (nominal changeover 14:30).

SENSITIVE: 00:58–01:24 Police arrested a trespassed male at McDonald's Britomart (Commercial Bay precinct) — HOTC team attended to assist and stood by only; no force used by the team; unrelated to the Reign & Pour matter.
QA: 11:48 anonymous assistance call was withdrawn when the individual left of their own accord; the caller hung up before they could be identified — counted as a call received.
